title: Race-window tests for Codex account admission held by delegation follow-up, fork and shutdown
outcome: Tests fail if a delegation follow-up or a Codex fork releases its launch admission early, or if an account action can publish after shutdown starts.
acceptance: A test starts an account action from inside a delegation follow-up while it holds its launch admission (for example via the existing TEST_REVIEW_BEFORE_FOLLOWUP_RESERVATION hook) and shows the action refused with the local-work conflict and the generation unchanged.
A test does the same from inside a Codex fork's thread/fork RPC.
A test triggers shutdown before begin_codex_account_operation and shows that no operation is published.
